summary: Frontend-only invitation site for Aditiri Arya tested end-to-end on mobile viewport (420x820). All 14 listed feature checkpoints pass. Welcome splash renders with Ganesha image and mantra, both language buttons (en/hi) dismiss splash, all 10 invitation sections present and reachable, countdown timer ticking with valid 4 cards (Days/Hours/Minutes/Seconds), Get Directions href correct, Google Maps iframe loads, all 3 RSVP cards have correct phones (9279210373/7903021500/9835511857) with proper tel: and wa.me links, share dock has whatsapp/copy/native buttons, memory gallery has 6 photo cards, no horizontal overflow on mobile, SEO title contains 'Aditiri Arya', OG meta tags present, Hindi switch renders Devanagari hero text, no React errors/warnings.

ui_bugs.issue: Audio toggle icon does not change state after click. Root cause: AMBIENT_AUDIO URL https://cdn.pixabay.com/audio/2022/03/15/audio_4f80b1d4f4.mp3 returns HTTP 403 (visible in console as two 403 errors). a.play() rejects, useEffect catch block calls setPlaying(false), so icon remains VolumeX even after user clicks. The button itself is clickable/accessible — only the play state never becomes true because the media file is unavailable.

action_items: Replace AMBIENT_AUDIO URL in /app/frontend/src/data/content.js — pixabay CDN URL returns 403. Use a reliable royalty-free source (e.g., a self-hosted file in /public, or a mixkit/freesound URL with proper CORS) so the audio toggle icon actually toggles between Volume2 and VolumeX. Optionally, also keep the icon in sync visually even if play() fails (decouple the icon from the audio element's success — currently the catch block force-pauses the visual state).
critical_code_review_comments: AudioController couples visual state to audio.play() success — when the network audio fails (e.g., 403/CORS) the toggle silently snaps back to paused, which looks like a broken button. Consider keeping setPlaying(true) on user click and only logging the play() failure, OR show a small 'audio unavailable' tooltip.
WelcomeSplash uses window.innerHeight in motion animate prop directly at render — fine for a single-mount splash but be aware this is captured at first render only.
Invitation.jsx is ~575 lines — within the 700-line guideline but borderline; consider splitting each Section into its own file for maintainability.
ShareDock uses document.execCommand('copy') as fallback — deprecated; modern clipboard API fallback to a temporary textarea + selection is OK but consider feature-detecting execCommand.
All required data-testids are present and well-named — excellent for testing.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on listed features (1 medium issue: audio playback due to 403 CDN URL — toggle button itself works)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only invite site. Public URL https://aditiri-welcome.preview.emergentagent.com. Test on mobile 420x820. Wait ~2.5s after navigation for splash animations to settle, then click [data-testid='lang-select-en' or 'lang-select-hi']. After language pick, splash takes ~900ms to exit (handleSelect setTimeout). All 10 sections use whileInView animations — scroll into view to trigger. Audio toggle: AMBIENT_AUDIO is currently a 403 URL; main agent needs to replace it. Once replaced, retest icon swap (Volume2 ↔ VolumeX) on click.
rca of the issue: Audio icon stuck on VolumeX. Network tab/console shows two GET 403 responses for cdn.pixabay.com/audio/2022/03/15/audio_4f80b1d4f4.mp3. Flow: splash dismissed → setAudioPlaying(true) → AudioController useEffect runs a.play() → promise rejects (403) → catch sets playing=false → icon = VolumeX. User clicks toggle → setPlaying(true) → effect again calls play() → still 403 → catch sets playing=false → icon stays VolumeX. Mitigation: (1) replace audio URL with a working royalty-free MP3 hosted reliably or bundled in /public; (2) optionally decouple icon state from play() failure so the button is at least visually responsive.
